Street food to formal dining
Music, games, storytelling every night
Workers, mercenaries, guides available
Someone in here knows someone
Small group of experienced fighters for hire. Cheaper than a full company, better than nothing.
Retired soldiers supplementing the village watch. Reliable, cheap, and unwilling to be bribed.
Basic weapons training for village militia. They will not be knights, but they will not die in the first volley.
Posted bounties for verified monster kills. Bring proof: claw, ear, or head.
Adventuring party escort through dangerous territory. Higher cost, higher capability than guards.
Full site clearance of dangerous locations. Quoted per job.
Recovery of persons taken by monsters, bandits, or worse. No guarantee of success.
Catch of the day. Buy and cook same-day.
Preserved fish for travel or winter.
Rendered fish oil for lamps and waterproofing.
Venison, boar, rabbit. Seasonal and fresh.
A tracker who knows the territory.

Register noble titles, land grants, and hereditary claims.
Rare opportunity to petition the monarch directly.
Write contracts, letters, and official documents for illiterate clients.
Properly formatted wills, deeds, and binding contracts.
Compose letters on behalf of clients. Discretion assured.
Copy existing texts and documents. Slower and more expensive than printing.
Tend, protect, and move flocks between pastures.
Annual fleece harvesting. Seasonal work.
Sell sheep and lambs for meat, breeding, and leather.
Clean, stitch, and dress wounds. Prevent infection where possible.
Treat common diseases and fevers with the knowledge available.
Assist with difficult births and postnatal complications.
Move restricted goods across borders and through customs.
Move people who cannot travel openly: fugitives, spies, deserters.
Conceal goods in false walls, underground caches, and decoy shipments.
Receive and pass on goods along the smuggling chain.
Temporary safe shelter for smugglers and their cargo.
Complex metal components for clocks, mechanisms, and specialist tools.
Bronze, brass, steel, and specialist alloys to commission.
Engineering advice on structural metalwork and mechanical systems.
Repair precision instruments, magical devices, and complex mechanisms.
Feed, water, and shelter privately-owned horses.
Full groom, exercise, and health monitoring for boarded horses.
Rent horses for local or short-distance travel.
Feed and shelter for traveler's horses during stays.
Full overnight care for horses.
Pickpocketing, muggings, and opportunistic theft in their territory.
Know who goes where in their district. Sellable information.
Apply muscle for local criminals who need a task done cheaply.
Convert raw hides into finished leather ready for cobblers, saddlers, and armourers.
Belts, bags, and basic leather items produced in-house.
Source hides from butchers and slaughterhouses at scale.
Basic tanning of animal hides into usable leather.
High-volume leather production for large contracts.
Ale, wine, and spirits across multiple establishments.
Hot food in most establishments. Quality ranges from pottage to roasted meats.
Beds or floor space available in most taverns.
Drinking loosens tongues. Useful for gathering news and rumour.
Plays, comedies, tragedies, and spectacles performed by professional companies.
Hire theater space during off-hours for private performances or rehearsals.
Theatrical wardrobes and props available for hire.
Targeted theft of specific items. Professional and discreet.
Move stolen goods through legitimate-seeming channels.
Information on individuals, security arrangements, and valuables.
Pay the guild and small criminal operations are left alone.
Rotating addresses across the city, no two known to the same people. Lent at the guild's discretion.
Coordinate pickpocketing, burglary, and robbery within the district.
Local fence network for chapter members.
A room kept ready for members who need to be elsewhere for a while. Guild business only.
Chapter-level protection for allied criminal operations.
Collect toll from all who cross. Rate varies by load and cargo.
Check loads for contraband or unpaid duties.
Proclaim laws, royal decrees, and official notices to the public.
Paid announcements for merchants, events, and wanted notices.
Patrol the streets after dark. Deter crime and respond to incidents.
Check travelers entering and leaving. Note unusual visitors.
Respond to reported crimes and pursue fleeing suspects.
Beds for travelers. Range from dormitory to private room.
Hot meals suited to travelers. Hearty portions.
Innkeepers know the roads. Ask about conditions, hazards, and distances.

p: INSTITUTION_SERVICES.Traveling hedge wizard.Minor spells for hire.desc
text: Small practical spells performed for a fee. Mending, light, messages.
pool: INSTITUTION_SERVICES.Traveling hedge wizard.Minor spells for hire.desc

text: Divination and portent reading. Accuracy uncertain.
Sell unusual ingredients and components acquired on travels.
Skeletons and zombies perform dangerous or exhausting physical work. No pay, no food, no complaints.
Undead don't need light or rest. Valuable for night-shift operations.
Tasks too dangerous for living workers. Toxic environments, unstable structures.
Songs, dances, and music for celebrations and gatherings.
Basic instruction for interested students.
Manage village affairs on behalf of the lord. Allocate strips and common access.
Settle minor disputes before they require higher authority.
Collect dues owed to the lord and accounting for common resources.
Write letters for illiterate villagers.
Read official documents and explain their contents.
Write down and witness simple agreements between parties.
Weave wool, linen, and other fibres into cloth for clothing and trade.
Weave to specific patterns and specifications for wealthy clients.
Colour cloth in a range of shades. Bright dyes are expensive.
Waterfowl, snipe, and upland birds caught in season.
Set and maintain traps across marshes and woodland.
Collect and sell feathers for fletching, bedding, and quill pens.
Large-scale regularized slave auctions with multiple blocks and licensed auctioneers.
Commission-based intermediary between slave traders and buyers.
Official record of owned persons, transfers of title, and manumission papers.
Receive, quarantine, and process incoming slave shipments from distant regions.
Premium matching of skilled enslaved artisans, scribes, and tutors to buyers.
People go missing. Usually blamed on bandits or the river.
False freedom papers, altered identities, forged ownership documents.
Safe houses and handoff points moving persons without attracting attention.
Furniture, shelving, and basic woodwork. Jack of all wooden trades.
Fix structural problems, patch roofs, and replace rotted timbers.
Apply and maintain reed or straw thatch roofing. The primary roofing material for common buildings.
Assess existing thatch condition and plan replacement timing.
Watertight barrels for ale, wine, salted meat, and fish. Essential packaging for trade.
Re-coopering and repair of used barrels. Cheaper than new for small leaks.
Specialty containers: butter churns, water buckets, storage vats.
Dried herbs, tinctures, and simple remedies for common ailments.
Prepared medicines for fever, pain, and infection.
Basic diagnosis and treatment advice.
Prepare and inter the dead. Religious rites included where applicable.
Grave markers and carved memorial stones.
Ongoing care of family plots. Purchased in advance.
Dig, inter and close the grave. Rites where there is someone at hand to say them.
A cut fieldstone or a lettered board, made by whoever here can cut or carve.
Keeping a family's row clear of bramble and stock. Settled in labour more often than in coin.
Interment in the parish ground, with the rite that parish keeps.

p: INSTITUTION_SERVICES.Parish burial grounds.Register of the dead.desc
text: The sexton records who lies where. Consulted in inheritance disputes as often as in mourning.
pool: INSTITUTION_SERVICES.Parish burial grounds.Register of the dead.desc

text: Cut stones and lettered slabs, ordered from the masons who work the churchyard.
A block of ground held by a trade for its members and their households.
Interment outside the gates. The bearers and the cart are found by the ground.

p: INSTITUTION_SERVICES.Burial grounds and charnel house.Lifting and ossuary.desc
text: Bones lifted from filled ground once the term is up and stacked in the charnel house.
pool: INSTITUTION_SERVICES.Burial grounds and charnel house.Lifting and ossuary.desc

p: INSTITUTION_SERVICES.Burial grounds and charnel house.Perpetual plot.desc
